label: TP
reason: User input from request.getParameter flows directly into the SQL query string via doSomething without any sanitization. The doSomething function stores the input in a HashMap and retrieves it back to overwrite the local variable bar, effectively passing the raw user input to the SQL concatenation on line 67, enabling SQL Injection.

evidence.note: param captured and passed to doSomething, re-assigned from HashMap, flows to SQL
SQL string concatenates bar directly without encoding
